title: Kiritani Haruka — Together With Our Little Fans〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, good morning, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Were you practicing on the rooftop this morning? I think I caught a glimpse of you guys.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that was us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um... Can I ask you another question?
Did Airi come to school today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Airi?
Yes, she was practicing with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She seems anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, I think I know why...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to meet Airi?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been blessed enough to be able to meet quite a few of my fans up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, I can sort of tell what a person's thinking based on their facial expression.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You can...?!
That's amazing, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
C-Can I really meet her...?
There's something I really want to tell her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I'll ask Airi to set aside some time before we practice during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Thank you so much!!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, hold on...
Didn't we meet in the courtyard once?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we did! Thank you for letting me know that my ribbons were coming undone that one time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's also something else that I didn't get to tell you then! Airi, all the hard work you put into being on TV gave me so much courage and hope...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Watching the stream of the graduation event you guys did at that elementary school reminded me of how I felt back then, and...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for setting aside this time for me. I know you're always busy practicing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure!
I'm glad we got to talk like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You too, Haruka!
Oh, Minori and Shizuku too! Thanks for having me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You made her so happy, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you really did!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for being so accommodating, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I need to thank you as well, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's one of Shii's most precious childhood friends, so what you just did means quite a bit to me as well..

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, I wouldn't be much of an idol if I didn't do stuff like this! Am I right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You're right, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I should be the one thanking all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm guessing you already know, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Until just recently, I had myself convinced that Variety Show Airi Momoi never really spread any hope to anyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So hearing that some people out there were encouraged by what I did back then couldn't make me happier...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And they ended up saving me instead of the other way around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's so great if you think about it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're doing our best to spread hope to others, but it turns out that our fans have that power too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It makes me want to work even harder for them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's a nice way to look at it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whenever we're feeling down, whenever we're not feeling great, hearing from our fans is the best cure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We need to do everything we can moving forward to inspire as much hope as we can in others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, we're running a little late, but shall we get started with practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
